description: Create a new user account in JFrog Artifactory with the following details: Username: 'john_doe', Email: 'john.doe@company.com', Password: 'JohnDoe@123', make the user a non-admin user. Log in to Artifactory at http://localhost:8082 using username 'admin' and password 'password'. Navigate to Administration > Security > Users, click '+ New User', fill in the details, and save. The user 'john_doe' must appear in the users list when done.
